en: Vintage monochrome postcard-style illustration of a rural cottage scene. It shows a thatched-roof house partly covered with ivy, surrounded by tall trees and dense garden foliage. In the foreground there is a pond or small river with reeds and grasses along the bank. A woman in a long, light-colored dress stands near the garden fence, appearing to tend plants or look toward the house. The edges of the image fade into the white card border, and there is no visible printed caption or text on the front.
